headline: Haplotype-resolved references reshape association and expression analysis
label: Pangenome And Haplotype Resolution
summary: Recent pig, Capsicum, apple and pedigree studies show haplotype-aware references changing downstream genetic and expression inference.
synthesis: The common thread is the replacement of a single linear reference with haplotype-resolved assemblies and pangenome graphs, and the propagation of that representation into downstream inference. In the apple study, a matched parent-of-origin-resolved Granny Smith genome changes RNA-seq differential expression and the biological conclusions drawn from it. The Capsicum workflow uses a graph pangenome to localize k-mer GWAS hits and link capsaicinoid and aroma traits to haplotypes and candidate loci. PolyOrigin2 addresses the upstream haplotype reconstruction step in multi-generational diploid and tetraploid pedigrees. The pig pan-genome, with three T2T and sixteen high-quality assemblies, extends this to centromere evolution, structural variation and genotype-phenotype mapping. The new element is the integration of haplotype-aware representation across reference construction, association testing and expression analysis, although the items occupy different stages of this pipeline.
